details.name: Mi Fu
details.quote: Enough talk. This time, I'll clean up the mess for you. But I do things directly. If something breaks, Endfield foots the bills.
details.infection: Oripathy positive, based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Constitution: Hardened Fortitude The ultimate cultivation refines the inner Qi, and hardens muscle, bone, and skin. A pugilist deals a meteoric swing, and has a body unscathed by enemy fists.
details.exp2d: Combat Technique: Hexeress of Wuling After getting bloodied by Mi Fu, her enemies began to call her a Hexeress. She likes the nickname very much.
details.hb1d: Lifestyle: Yanese Desserts Ice jelly, sugared lotus roots, osmanthus cakes, and sugar rice cakes... She visits the vendors often, but hardly anyone sees her eating them.
details.hb2d: Sports: Martial Friendship "Thank you for the lesson. Let our fists of no regrets cross." "Well said. Do not hold back, and let Fate decide how the waters flow."
